en_title: Marvel Knew David Jonsson Would Be the Next Black Panther 6 Months Ago After 'Secret Meeting' With Ryan Coogler
cn_title: David Jonsson半年前已秘密获选新黑豹
subtitle: 库格勒一眼认定接班人

images.caption: 图片来源：Jesse Grant/Getty Images for Disney

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios knew David Jonsson would star in Black Panther 3 'five or six months' ago thanks to a 'secret meeting' director Ryan Coogler Held with Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) boss Kevin Feige.
paragraphs.cn: 由于导演瑞恩·库格勒与漫威电影宇宙（MCU）掌门人凯文·费奇进行了一次「秘密会面」，漫威影业早在「五六个月前」就知道David Jonsson将主演《黑豹3》。

paragraphs.en: The MCU mastermind spoke about the casting process during a conversation with Empire at San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC) 2026. During their post-Hall H chat, Feige recalled the moment Coogler reached out to pitch the idea of Jonsson leading Black Panther 3 as the next Black Panther.
paragraphs.cn: 这位MCU掌舵人在2026年圣迭戈国际动漫展（SDCC）期间接受《帝国》杂志采访，谈到了选角过程。在H厅活动后的对谈中，费奇回忆起库格勒联系自己、提议让Jonsson以新任黑豹身份领衔《黑豹3》的那一刻。

paragraphs.en: The Marvel Studios head said an official search for an actor to play the son of the late Chadwick Boseman's character, T'Challa, when Coogler initially got in touch. Although the director was busy at the time, it sounds like Jonsson has been on his mind for months.
paragraphs.cn: 费奇表示，库格勒最初联系他时，漫威影业尚未正式开始寻找饰演已故演员查德维克·博斯曼所塑造角色特查拉之子的演员。尽管导演当时工作繁忙，但听起来Jonsson已经在他心中停留了数月。

paragraphs.en: "I’ll give you the real scoop," Feige said. "We hadn’t started a search yet. Ryan was working on Sinners , and when Ryan works on a project he’s all in. So the presumption very much was we would sit with him after Sinners came out, after the Academy campaign. We were waiting 'til after the Academy Awards to sit with Ryan and begin that process.
paragraphs.cn: 费奇说：「我来告诉你真正的内幕。我们当时还没有启动选角。瑞恩正在制作《罪人》，而他一旦投入一个项目就会全力以赴。所以原本的打算是等《罪人》上映、奥斯卡宣传季结束后再和他坐下来谈。我们一直准备等到奥斯卡颁奖礼之后，再与瑞恩会面并启动这个过程。」

paragraphs.en: "A month and a half or so before that process, he called me and said, 'I found him.' I said, 'What do you mean?' He goes, 'I found him. He's this guy, David Jonsson.' He mentioned his movies. I had seen some of them. I watched more. He goes, 'I'm going to meet him.'"
paragraphs.cn: 「大约在正式启动选角的一个半月前，他打电话对我说：『我找到他了。』我问：『什么意思？』他说：『我找到他了，就是这个人，David Jonsson。』他提到了Jonsson出演的电影，其中一些我看过，之后又补看了更多。他接着说：『我要去见他。』」

paragraphs.en: Jonsson is a British actor and has been a rising star in Hollywood for the last few years. First starring in lesser-known roles with projects like Endeavour and Deep State, the actor eventually went on to receive praise for his time as Andy the android in 2024's Alien: Romulus . Last year, he nailed another standout part as Peter in the live-action adaptation of Stephen King's The Long Walk .
paragraphs.cn: Jonsson是一名英国演员，过去几年间逐渐成为好莱坞新星。他早期在《摩斯探长前传》和《深暗势力》等作品中出演知名度不高的角色，后来凭借2024年《异形：夺命舰》中的仿生人安迪收获赞誉。去年，他又在斯蒂芬·金小说改编的真人电影《漫漫长路》中出色饰演彼得。

paragraphs.en: His time on screens big and small caught Coogler's attention, and as of Marvel Studios' Hall H panel last night, he's set to be the next Black Panther . When he shows up in Black Panther 3, he'll be joined by Letitia Wright as Shuri and Winston Duke as M'Baku. Feige said Jonsson's inclusion is a casting choice Coogler and the rest of Marvel have kept secret longer than some might have guessed.
paragraphs.cn: Jonsson在大小银幕上的表现引起库格勒注意，而在漫威影业昨晚的H厅发布会后，他已确定成为下一任黑豹。他在《黑豹3》中亮相时，莱蒂希娅·赖特饰演的舒莉和温斯顿·杜克饰演的姆巴库也会回归。费奇称，库格勒和漫威其他成员保守这项选角秘密的时间，比很多人猜想的更久。

paragraphs.en: "He had a secret meeting with him under cloak of darkness in a hotel somewhere, and called me afterwards and said, 'He's the guy, he's the guy, I felt it. I felt it in my soul. He's a good man, and he is the next Black Panther,'" Feige added. "And I got chills, and I got a little welled-up and said, 'Let’s do it.' So we've been sitting on this secret for a good five or six months."
paragraphs.cn: 费奇补充道：「他借着夜色，在某家酒店与Jonsson秘密见面。会后他打电话对我说：『就是他，就是他，我感觉到了，发自灵魂地感觉到了。他是个好人，也就是下一任黑豹。』我听得浑身起鸡皮疙瘩，眼眶也有些湿润，然后说：『那就这么办。』所以我们把这个秘密藏了整整五六个月。」

paragraphs.en: Black Panther 3 premieres December 15, 2028. For more, you can read about how Ryan Gosling finally landed the part of Ghost Rider . You can also catch up on everything else announced during the Marvel Hall H panel .
paragraphs.cn: 《黑豹3》将于2028年12月15日上映。你还可以了解瑞恩·高斯林最终如何获得恶灵骑士一角，以及漫威H厅发布会公布的其他全部消息。

summary: 凯文·费奇透露，瑞恩·库格勒在漫威正式启动选角前便秘密会见David Jonsson，并认定他就是下一任黑豹。漫威已将这项决定保密五六个月，Jonsson将在2028年上映的《黑豹3》中登场。
opus_summary: 库格勒秘密会见David Jonsson后便告诉费奇：「他就是下一任黑豹。」漫威为此保密五六个月，直到SDCC才正式公开。
